title: Define and independently review the unified workflow contracts
body:
## Outcome
Produce the bounded architecture contract that all implementation children consume.

## Scope and acceptance
Inventory every current public intent and map it to private operations; define the evidence envelope, phase DAG, next-step/action audience, batching, approval, lease and log interfaces. Specify content-hash boundaries, policy invalidation, parent/child authority, worker grouping and stack gates without introducing a general workflow engine. Resolve cross-machine storage atomicity and liveness-probe feasibility with disposable probes. Independently review consequential decisions before downstream implementation; record concrete open decisions as blockers.

## Baseline and falsifiable verification
Current ZzzOps uses separate commands and prose-driven execution; #429 did not ensure the real agent followed delegation. Trace every agreed requirement to an owning child and validate representative examples for stale evidence, partial batches, lease recovery and root-only approval. Independent architectural review must find no unresolved blocking contract gaps.

## Boundaries
Implements parent #430. Follow the [agreed design](https://github.com/david-rzepa/zzzops/issues/430#issuecomment-5704365166) and [efficiency/root-only interaction constraints](https://github.com/david-rzepa/zzzops/issues/430#issuecomment-5704529135). No parent implementation or general workflow-engine expansion. Stop affected work on unresolved contract or authority gaps; preserve useful independent preparation. Dependencies gate implementation, not read-only preparation.
